   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_024

   Content: Congratulations on earning rewards with your Rho-Bank credit card! Whether you've been saving up your points for something special or you're ready to cash in on your hard-earned rewards, we want to make sure you know all the ways you can put those rewards to good use.

## Ways to Redeem Your Rewards

Rho-Bank offers several flexible options for redeeming your credit card rewards, so you can choose the method that works best for you:

### Statement Credit
Apply your rewards directly to your credit card balance. This is one of the simplest redemption options—your rewards are converted to a dollar amount and subtracted from what you owe on your next statement.

### Rho-Bank Checking Account Deposit
If you have a Rho-Bank checking account, you can transfer your rewards directly into your checking account as cash. This gives you immediate access to your rewards for everyday spending.

### Travel Through the Rho-Bank Travel Portal
Book flights, hotels, and car rentals through the Rho-Bank Travel Portal and your rewards may be worth even more. Many of our cards offer enhanced value when you redeem for travel purchases through our portal.

### Gift Cards
Choose from a wide selection of gift cards from popular retailers, restaurants, and entertainment venues. Gift cards make great presents or a nice treat for yourself.

### Charitable Donations
Feel good about your rewards by donating them to one of our partner charities. It's an easy way to give back while putting your rewards to meaningful use.

### Merchandise
Browse the Rho-Bank Rewards Mall for electronics, home goods, apparel, and more. You can use your rewards to shop for items you want without spending cash.

### Airline Miles Transfer
For select premium cards, you can transfer your rewards to partner airline frequent flyer programs. This can be a great option if you're working toward a specific travel goal.

## Tips for Maximizing Value

- Check the redemption rates for each option, as the value per point can vary
- Some redemption methods offer better value than others—travel redemptions often provide the best return
- Keep an eye out for special promotions that may offer bonus value on certain redemption types
- There's no rush—your rewards don't expire as long as your account is open and in good standing

## How to Redeem

You can redeem your rewards anytime through the Rho-Bank mobile app, online banking at rhobank.com, or by calling our customer service team at 1-800-RHO-BANK. If you have questions about which redemption option is right for you, our team is happy to help you make the most of your rewards.

1. Silver Plus Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
   ID: doc_savings_accounts_silver_plus_account_007
   Score: 16.6385
   Content: ## Mobile deposit limits
- You can deposit checks through the mobile app up to a daily total of $5,000. If your deposit total for the day reaches $5,000, additional mobile deposits will need to wait until the next day.

## Transfers via mobile and online banking
- Outbound transfers are limited to a maximum of $10,000 per day. If you schedule multiple transfers in one day, their combined total cannot exceed $10,000.

## Helpful features in the app
- Automatic round-up savings is supported: Yes. Enable it on your linked debit card to move spare change into savings with each purchase.

2. Moving Money Between Your Rho-Bank Accounts
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_022
   Score: 12.8643
   Content: One of the many conveniences of being a Rho-Bank customer is the ability to easily move money between your accounts. Whether you're transferring funds from your checking account to your savings account to build up your emergency fund, moving money from savings to checking to cover an upcoming expense, or simply reorganizing your finances across multiple accounts, Rho-Bank makes it simple and straightforward.

## Self-Service Options

The fastest way to transfer money between your Rho-Bank accounts is through our digital banking platforms. Using the Rho-Bank mobile app or online banking at rhobank.com, you can initiate transfers instantly, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Simply log in, navigate to the transfer section, select your source and destination accounts, enter the amount, and confirm. It's that easy, and there's no fee for transferring money between your own Rho-Bank accounts.

## Need Assistance? We're Here to Help

If you prefer to have a customer service representative handle the transfer for you, or if you're having any trouble with the digital platforms, our team is happy to assist. Simply call us at 1-800-RHO-BANK or chat with us through the mobile app, and we can process the transfer on your behalf. This can be especially convenient if you're setting up a new savings account and want us to transfer the opening deposit from your checking account, or if you need to consolidate balances across multiple accounts.

## A Few Things to Keep in Mind

Both the source account (where the money is coming from) and the destination account (where the money is going) must be open and in good standing. The source account must have sufficient funds to cover the transfer amount—if the balance is too low, the transfer won't go through. Internal transfers between your own Rho-Bank accounts are always free of charge.

At Rho-Bank, we want managing your money to be as effortless as possible. If you have any questions about transferring funds or need any other assistance with your accounts, please don't hesitate to reach out. We're always here to help.

3. Welcome to Rho-Bank Checking
   ID: doc_checking_accounts_checking_accounts_(general)_001
   Score: 12.8048
   Content: ## Get started today
- Enroll in online and mobile access to view balances, track activity, and manage alerts.
- Add your debit card to your digital wallet for fast, secure checkout.
- Set up direct deposit with your employer or income sources to streamline cash flow.

## Manage everyday banking
- Pay bills, schedule payments, and set reminders to avoid missing due dates.
- Make secure transfers between your Rho-Bank accounts.
- Transfer funds to external accounts in a matter of days.

## Tips for a smooth first month
- Review your statements and recent activity to confirm payees and amounts.
- Set up account alerts for low balance, large transactions, and deposits to stay informed.
- If you plan to move money out, keep enough in your account to cover any pending transactions and recurring payments.

## Need help?
- Use secure messaging or call support from within your online banking profile.
- Have your account details ready so we can assist you quickly.

4. Need Your Transaction History? Our Team Can Help
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_021
   Score: 12.7883
   Content: At Rho-Bank, we believe in complete transparency when it comes to your money. We understand that there are many reasons why you might need to access a detailed record of your transaction history—whether you're preparing your taxes, keeping track of business expenses, reconciling your budget, disputing a charge, or simply trying to understand where your money has been going. Whatever your reason, our customer service team is here to help you get the information you need quickly and easily.

While you can always view your recent transactions through the Rho-Bank mobile app or online banking portal, our customer service representatives have access to comprehensive tools that can provide you with even more detailed information. When you contact us, we can pull your complete transaction history for any checking or savings account, including:

- All posted and pending transactions
- Detailed transaction descriptions and dates
- Fee breakdowns and explanations
- Rebates and credits that have been applied
- Interest payments
- Transfer details between accounts

This can be especially helpful if you're looking for a specific transaction from several months ago, need documentation for a particular time period, or want to understand the details behind a specific fee or credit on your account.

## Contact Us

To request your transaction history or ask questions about specific transactions, simply call us at 1-800-RHO-BANK, chat with us through the Rho-Bank mobile app, or visit our online help center at rhobank.com/help. Our friendly and knowledgeable representatives are standing by and ready to assist you. At Rho-Bank, helping you stay informed and in control of your finances is always our top priority.

5. Platinum Plus Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
   ID: doc_savings_accounts_platinum_plus_account_007
   Score: 12.3975
   Content: ## Mobile check deposit
- Daily mobile deposit limit: $75,000

## Transfers in mobile and online banking
- Maximum daily outbound transfers: $250,000

### Tips
- If you expect activity above $75,000 or $250,000, contact your banker in advance to discuss temporary limit reviews.

6. Bronze Saver Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
   ID: doc_business_savings_accounts_bronze_saver_account_005
   Score: 12.3695
   Content: ## Mobile check deposit
- You can deposit checks via mobile banking up to a daily total of $2,500.
- If you attempt to submit mobile deposits above $2,500, the app may prevent submission and prompt you to try again later or use another deposit method.

## Transfers from the app
- Outgoing transfers are limited to $5,000 per day.
- If your requested transfer would exceed $5,000, you will be prompted to reduce the amount or split transfers across multiple days.

## Tips for smooth processing
- Submit mobile deposits and transfers early in the day to allow for review and processing.
- Retain check images and confirmations until you see the deposit reflected in your account activity.

7. FAQ: Green Account (savings)
   ID: doc_savings_accounts_green_account_(savings)_005
   Score: 11.8411
   Content: ## Frequently asked questions

- 4.0%

### Do I need to maintain a minimum balance?
- Yes. The minimum balance requirement is $500.

### Is there a monthly maintenance fee if I do not meet the minimum balance?
- $0.00

### Can I boost my APY by pairing with an EcoCard or Green Rewards Card?
- Yes. You can receive a bonus of 0.5%.

### Does Rho-Bank match donations to partner environmental charities?
- Yes. Rho-Bank matches at 50%.

### How do I confirm my rate and benefits?
- Review your account details in online or mobile banking to see your current APY of 4.0% and any applicable bonus of 0.5%.

8. Refer a Friend to Rho-Bank and Earn Rewards
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_020
   Score: 11.5919
   Content: Do you love your Rho-Bank credit card? Share the love with friends and family, and you could both earn rewards! Our referral program makes it easy to invite the people you care about to join Rho-Bank, and when they're approved for a new card and meet the program requirements, you'll both be rewarded.

## How It Works

Participating in our referral program is simple. When you refer someone to apply for a Rho-Bank credit card and they're approved, you may be eligible to receive a referral bonus. The specific bonus amount and requirements vary depending on which credit card you're referring them to—some cards offer cash back bonuses, while others may offer bonus points or statement credits.

## Getting Your Referral Link

To refer a friend, you'll need to generate a unique referral link that's tied to your account. You can do this through the Rho-Bank mobile app, online banking portal, or by contacting our customer service team. Once you have your link, simply share it with friends and family via email, text, or social media. When they use your link to apply and are approved, the referral will be tracked to your account.

## Important Things to Know

To ensure the referral program remains fair for all participants, there are a few guidelines to keep in mind:

- **Weekly Limit**: You can earn referral bonuses for up to 2 successful referrals per week. This is calculated on a rolling 7-day basis, so if you've already had 2 referrals complete in the past week, any additional referrals during that time won't qualify for a bonus.
- **Eligibility**: Not all credit cards participate in the referral program. Before sharing your link, make sure the card you're referring has an active referral offer.
- **Bonus Requirements**: Each referral program has specific requirements that your friend must meet to trigger the bonus, such as making a certain amount of purchases within a specified timeframe after account opening.

## Check Your Referral Status

You can track the status of your referrals at any time through the Rho-Bank mobile app or by contacting customer service. We'll also send you notifications when your referrals are approved and when you earn your bonus.

If you have any questions about the referral program or want to confirm the current offer for your card, please reach out to our customer service team at 1-800-RHO-BANK. We're always happy to help!

9. Understanding Your Credit Card Rewards Categories
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_019
   Score: 11.2513
   Content: One of the great benefits of your Rho-Bank credit card is the ability to earn rewards on your everyday purchases. To help you maximize your earnings, it's important to understand how reward categories work and which types of purchases qualify for bonus rewards on your specific card.

## How Reward Categories Work

Every Rho-Bank credit card earns rewards on all purchases, but certain categories of spending may earn you bonus rewards at a higher rate. Your card has a base reward rate that applies to all purchases, plus bonus categories where you can earn even more. The specific bonus categories and rates vary depending on which Rho-Bank credit card you have.

## Available Reward Categories

Rho-Bank recognizes the following spending categories for rewards purposes:

- **Travel**: Flights, hotels, car rentals, cruises, and other travel-related purchases
- **Dining**: Restaurants, cafes, bars, and food delivery services
- **Groceries**: Supermarkets, grocery stores, and specialty food shops
- **Entertainment**: Movies, concerts, sporting events, and streaming services
- **Shopping**: Retail stores, department stores, and online marketplaces
- **Utilities**: Electric, gas, water, internet, and phone bills
- **Transportation**: Rideshare services, public transit, parking, and tolls
- **Software**: Software subscriptions, licenses, and cloud services
- **Media**: Advertising spend and digital media purchases
- **Green/Sustainable**: Eco-friendly merchants and sustainable products
- **Operations**: Business operational expenses

## Maximizing Your Rewards

To get the most out of your rewards, we recommend using your Rho-Bank credit card for purchases in your card's bonus categories whenever possible. You can find your specific card's bonus categories and reward rates by logging into your account on the Rho-Bank mobile app or website, or by reviewing your card's terms and conditions.

If you have any questions about which category a particular merchant falls into, or how to maximize your rewards earning potential, our customer service team is always happy to help. Give us a call at 1-800-RHO-BANK or chat with us through the mobile app.

10. Emerald Saver Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
   ID: doc_business_savings_accounts_emerald_saver_005
   Score: 11.1791
   Content: ## Daily mobile deposit limit
- You can deposit up to $7,500 per day using mobile check deposit.
- Deposits that exceed $7,500 should be split across multiple days or submitted by another channel.

## Daily transfer‑out limit via mobile and online
- The maximum you can transfer out per day is $15,000.
- Both scheduled and immediate transfers count toward $15,000.

## What counts toward your limits
- All mobile check deposits made within the same calendar day apply to the $7,500 cap.
- Internal and external transfers initiated in digital banking apply to the $15,000 cap.

## Managing activity within limits
- If you are approaching $7,500, hold additional deposits for a subsequent day to avoid rejection.
- For larger payments, plan multiple transfers across days so each stays within $15,000.
- Check your remaining limit in digital banking before initiating additional activity.
